module: Automatically places decorative objects (TSStatic, for example reflectors or posts) on each side of a DecalRoad, at regular intervals. The objects are placed at terrain height, registered under "decoration.<road>.<file>.<n>" and grouped in a SimGroup added to MissionGroup. A modder calls it from an editor script.
usage:
-- a reflector 2 m from the edge, every 25 m, left/right sides aligned
local grp = editor_roadDecorations.decorateProps('myRoad', 'levels/driver_training/art/shapes/objects/reflector.dae', 2, 25, nil, 0, true)
notes: BUG: the group name is built with string.format('decorations.%d', tostring(roadName)); %d requires a number, so a non-numeric road name (string) raises an error. Only a numeric name (e.g. "9459") works.

The code documentation says the function returns the table of created objects, but it actually returns group:getID() (the SimGroup identifier); the props table is built but never returned. Returns nil if the road does not exist.
The props are oriented parallel to the road (quatFromDir of the flattened direction); the rotation parameter is a quaternion multiplied with this rotation (inferred from code), nil for none.
Each row has 2 objects (right then left) per step; the loop stops when either side goes past the end of the road.

findOffsetPoint.desc: Searches a polyline (road edge) for the point located at the given length from the start, then offsets it laterally. Returns nil if the length exceeds the polyline.

spline.desc: Points of the road edge (at least 2).

length.desc: Distance from the start, in meters.

distance.desc: Lateral offset toward the outside of the road, in meters.

left.desc: true for the left edge (reversed direction), false for the right edge.

returns.desc: {point = offset vec3, rotation = quat, edgePos = vec3 on the edge, edgeIdx = integer (C++ index, 0-based)} or nil.

decorateProps.desc: Creates a SimGroup and places in it, every `period` meters, a TSStatic on each side of the road (collisionType 'Collision Mesh', scale 1). The positions are snapped to the terrain (core_terrain.getTerrainHeight) then offset by zOff.

roadName.desc: Unique name of the DecalRoad (see bug: must be numeric).

shapeName.desc: Path of the .dae file to place.

distance.desc: Lateral offset from the road edge, in meters.

period.desc: Interval between two pairs of objects, in meters.

rotation.desc: Extra rotation applied to the objects (nil = none).

zOff.desc: Vertical offset added to the terrain height.

align.desc: true: the left side is placed as the exact opposite of the right side (same road length).

returns.desc: Identifier of the created SimGroup, or nil if the road does not exist.
